dedup.group_rule: rows are grouped in file order by normalize(question); a group takes the question of its first row and the union of aliases, normalized_aliases and value of its rows (row by row, in this order, first appearance, blank strings dropped) as its answers

normalize_rule: NFKC, lowercase, remove ASCII punctuation, remove the articles a/an/the, collapse whitespace

selection.pool_order: file order of the first row of the group
selection.rule: dev = the pilot groups + the 800 other groups with the smallest sha256('<seed>|development|<key>'); sealed = the 2000 groups with the smallest sha256('<seed>|sealed|<key>') among the groups in neither; both pools in the file order of the first row of the group
